name: Coffee shop "Keyhole"
detailed_description:
This is a mystery adventure game where you run a coffee shop and explore the mysteries of this coffee shop and this town!

Synopsis

This coffee shop has some secrets...

The main character quit his job as a locksmith and rented a property last month to run a coffee shop.

But this property seems to have a history...

Game system

Coffee shop management

You can discover new coffee blending methods by combining ingredients and extraction methods based on in-game hints like a puzzle.

You can check the day's trends from SNS and increase sales by making coffee that meets your customers' needs the recommended menu for the day. The money you earn from running the business will be used to advance the storyline and expand the shop's functionality.

Deduction

You will need to gather evidence from various sources by exploring the map, talking to certain people and sometimes even using social networking sites.

Here is a description of the main deduction system in the game

Exploring the map

You gather information by exploring the town and investigating suspicious places.

Conversations with specific people

Gather information from conversations. Sometimes you can get new information by making the right choices or by using the “Ask for more information” command.

Social networking

Gather information by searching for keywords in combination with keywords obtained from conversations, etc. You may be able to access important information such as past newspapers, as well as comments posted on social networking sites.

Presenting evidence

Get to the bottom of the case by presenting the evidence you have gathered and unravelling the mystery
